name: Teental (Tintal / Trital)
desc: The most common 16-matra cycle of Hindustani music, in four equal vibhags of 4. Theka: Dha Dhin Dhin Dha | Dha Dhin Dhin Dha | Dha Tin Tin Ta | Ta Dhin Dhin Dha; sam on 1, tali on 1/5/13, khali (wave) on 9.

name: Tilwada (Tilwara)
desc: A graceful 16-matra cycle (4+4+4+4) used for vilambit khayal as an alternative to Teental. Theka: Dha Tirkit Dhin Dhin | Dha Dha Tin Tin | Ta Tirkit Dhin Dhin | Dha Dha Dhin Dhin; tali on 1/5/13, khali on 9.

name: Sitarkhani (Addha-like, 16)
desc: A 16-matra (4+4+4+4) variant of Teental favored by instrumentalists, with a lilting syncopated dha on the off-beat of each vibhag. Tali on 1/5/13, khali on 9. Vocalists call the related theka Punjabi.

name: Punjabi Theka (16)
desc: The Punjabi variation of Teental (16, 4+4+4+4) popularized by Punjab musicians, sharing Sitarkhani's syncopation where paired dhins become a single off-beat dhin. Sam on 1, tali on 1/5/13, khali on 9.

name: Addha Teental (Addha, 16)
desc: Addha ('half') of Teental, a light 16-matra theka common in thumri and ghazal. Theka: Dha Dha Dhin Ta | Ta Dha Dhin Dha | Dha Dha Tin Ta | Ta Ta Dhin Dha; tali on 1/5/13, khali on 9.

name: Jhaptal (Jhaptaal)
desc: A 10-matra cycle in vibhags of 2+3+2+3. Theka: Dhin Na | Dhin Dhin Na | Tin Na | Dhin Dhin Na; sam on 1, tali on 1/3/8, khali (wave) on 6.

name: Sultal (Sooltal / Surfakta)
desc: A 10-matra pakhawaj tal of the dhrupad tradition in vibhags of 2 (clap, wave, clap, wave, clap). Theka commonly: Dha Dha | Din Ta | Kit Dha | Tirakita | Dhin Na; tali on 1/5/9, khali on 3/7.

name: Rupak (Roopak, classical)
desc: A 7-matra cycle in vibhags of 3+2+2, unique for beginning on khali (sam = wave). Theka: Tin Tin Na | Dhin Na | Dhin Na; khali on 1, tali on 4 and 6.

name: Rupak (light / semi-classical)
desc: The light/bhajan rendering of Rupak (7, 3+2+2) used in devotional and film songs, keeping the khali-tali-tali structure but with a simpler resonant theka. Khali on 1, tali on 4 and 6.

name: Tivra (Teevra)
desc: A 7-matra dhrupad tal in vibhags of 3+2+2. Theka: Dhin Dhin Dha | Tirakita Tu | Na Kat Ta (regional variants exist); sam/tali on 1 and 5, khali on 4.

name: Ektal (Ektaal)
desc: A 12-matra cycle in six vibhags of 2 (tali-khali-tali-khali-tali-tali). Theka: Dhin Dhin | Dhage Tirakita | Tu Na | Kat Ta | Dhage Tirakita | Dhin Na; tali on 1/5/9/11, khali on 3/7.

name: Chautal (Chartal)
desc: The standard 12-matra pakhawaj tal of dhrupad, vibhags 4+4+2+2 (or 2x6). Theka: Dha Dha Din Ta | Kita Dha Din Ta | Tete Kata | Gadi Gana; tali on 1/5/9/11, khali on 3/7.

name: Dadra (classical)
desc: A 6-matra light-classical cycle in two vibhags of 3. Theka: Dha Dhin Na | Dha Tin Na; sam/tali on 1, khali (wave) on 4. The basis of the dadra song genre.

name: Keherwa (Kaharva)
desc: The ubiquitous 8-matra folk/light cycle in two vibhags of 4. Theka: Dha Ge Na Ti | Na Ka Dhin Na; sam/tali on 1, khali on 5.

name: Bhajani Theka (Keherwa variant)
desc: The devotional bhajan rendering of Keherwa (8, 4+4). Theka: Dhin Ta Dhin Dhin | Ta Tin Ta Tin; sam/tali on 1, khali on 5. Heard throughout bhajans and kirtans.

name: Qawwali Theka (Keherwa variant)
desc: The forceful 8-matra Qawwali rendering of Keherwa used in Sufi devotional music. Theka: Dha Dhin Dha Dhe | Tira Ta Tin Ta; sam/tali on 1, khali on 5, driven by emphatic hand-claps.

name: Mughlai / Dhumali (Keherwa-family)
desc: Dhumali, an 8-matra (4+4) Keherwa-family theka with a Mughlai lilt used in light-classical thumri and dance. Theka: Dhin Dhin Dha Tirakita | Dhin Na Ge Na; sam/tali on 1, khali on 5.

name: Dhamar (Dhammar)
desc: A 14-matra dhrupad/dhamar tal in asymmetric vibhags 5+2+3+4, played with open pakhawaj strokes. Theka: Ka Dhi Ta Dhi Ta | Dha Ga | Ti Ta Ti | Ta Dhi Ta Dha; tali on 1/6/11, khali on 8.

name: Jhumra (Jhumra Tal)
desc: A stately 14-matra vilambit cycle in vibhags 3+4+3+4, used for bada khayal. Theka: Dhin Dha Tirakita | Dhin Dhin Dhage Tirakita | Tin Ta Tirakita | Dhin Dhin Dhage Tirakita; tali on 1/4/11, khali on 8.

name: Deepchandi (Dipchandi)
desc: A graceful 14-matra thumri/ghazal cycle in vibhags 3+4+3+4. Theka: Dha Dhin - | Dha Ge Tin - | Ta Tin - | Dha Ge Dhin -; tali on 1/4/11, khali on 8, with rests on 3/7/10/14.

name: Ada Chautal (Ara Chautal)
desc: A 14-matra khayal cycle in seven vibhags of 2. Theka: Dhin Tirkit | Dhin Na | Tu Na | Kat Ta | Tirkit Dhin | Na Dhin | Dhin Na; tali on 1/3/7/11, khali on 5/9/13.

name: Pharodast (Farodast)
desc: Pharodast, a 14-matra pakhawaj tal of seven vibhags of 2 used in dhrupad. Built from dha/kita/dhin phrasing across the cycle; sam on 1 with the customary clap-wave alternation of the seven divisions.

name: Pancham Sawari
desc: An intricate 15-matra cycle in asymmetric vibhags 3+4+4+4, used in khayal, kathak and tabla solos. Theka built on Dhi Na Dhidhi / Kat Dhidhi Nadhi Dhina phrasing; tali on 1/4/8/12, khali on 5.

name: Gajjhampa
desc: A rare 15-matra tal in four vibhags. Theka: Dha Dhin Nak Tak | Dha Dhin Nak Tak | Tin Nak Tak | Titt Kat Gdi Gan; tali on 1/5/12, khali on 9.

name: Matta Tal
desc: A 9-matra cycle in vibhags 2+2+2+3. Theka: Dhin Tirekite | Dhin Na | Tun Na | Dhindhin Nadhin Dhinna; tali on 1/3/7, khali on 5.

name: Shikhar Tal
desc: A rare 17-matra pakhawaj/kathak tal in vibhags 4+4+3+2+4, famed for having five talis and no khali. Theka: Dha Tirkit Dhin Nak | Thun Ga Dhin Nak | Dhom Kit Tak | Dhet Dha | Titt Kat Gdi Gan.

name: Brahma Tal
desc: A monumental 28-matra pakhawaj tal of fourteen vibhags of 2. Theka spans Dha Ki Ta / Ta Ka Dhu Ma / Ki Ta Ta Ka / Dhe T / Ti Ta Ka Ta / Ga Di Ga Na; many talis with khali on 3/9/17/27.

name: Lakshmi Tal
desc: A rare 18-matra cycle used in pakhawaj and kathak, built on resonant dha/dhin phrasing across multiple vibhags with the customary clap-wave alternation; sam on 1.

name: Ganesh Tal
desc: A rare 21-matra pakhawaj/kathak tal divided into multiple vibhags, named for Ganesha and built on open resonant dhrupad bols; sam on 1 with clap-wave alternation across its divisions.

name: Khemta (Khempta)
desc: A 6-matra light cycle (3+3) close to Dadra, used in folk and semi-classical songs. Theka: Dha Ti Na | Dhin Na Tina; sam/tali on 1, khali on 4.

name: Pashto (Pashtu)
desc: A 7-matra tal in vibhags 3+2+2 used in light-classical and dance music. Theka: Dhin Na Dhin | Dhin Na | Dha Tirkit; tali on 1/4/6 with no khali in the common form.

name: Dhumali (8, light)
desc: Dhumali, an 8-matra (4+4) thumri/dance theka of the Keherwa family with a swinging gait. Theka: Dhin Dhin Na | Tirakita Dhin Na Ge Na; sam/tali on 1, khali on 5.

name: Sawari Tal (Savari, 16)
desc: Sawari, a 16-matra cycle in four vibhags of 4 used in tabla solo and instrumental music, related to the sawari family of off-balance talas; tali on 1/5/13, khali on 9.

name: Basant Tal
desc: Basant, a 9-matra dhrupad tal associated with seasonal/spring compositions. Theka built on dha/din/ta phrasing across asymmetric vibhags; sam on 1 with clap-wave alternation.

name: Jhampak (Laghu Jhampa)
desc: A 10-matra cycle related to Jhaptal in vibhags 2+3+2+3, used in dhrupad and light-classical forms. Sam/tali on 1/3/8, khali on 6.

name: Trital Dugun (Sitarkhani Punjabi instrumental)
desc: The instrumental Sitarkhani/Punjabi 16-matra theka as played behind sitar and sarod gats, emphasizing the syncopated single dhin on the off-beat of each vibhag; tali on 1/5/13, khali on 9.

name: Roopak Bhajani (7, devotional)
desc: A devotional/abhang rendering of Rupak (7, 3+2+2) common in Marathi bhajan and Vaishnava kirtan, retaining khali on the sam (beat 1) with talis on 4 and 6.

name: Ektal Madhya (12, drut variant)
desc: The madhya/drut-laya rendering of Ektal (12, 2x6) used in fast khayal, where the theka condenses to Dhin Dhinna Tirkit Dhin Dhinna Dhage Tirkit; tali on 1/5/9/11, khali on 3/7.

name: Saartal (Sawaritaal, 12)
desc: Saartal (Soutal), a 12-matra pakhawaj tal related to Chautal used in dhrupad. Theka built on Dha Dha Din Ta / Kita Dha phrasing across vibhags; tali on 1/5/9/11, khali on 3/7.

name: Teevra Madhya (Tivra drut, 7)
desc: A faster madhya-laya rendering of Tivra (7, 3+2+2) used in instrumental gats and dhrupad, with the open resonant theka condensed; sam/tali on 1 and 5, khali on 4.

name: Brahma Tal (14, common)
desc: The common 14-matra form of Brahma Tal in seven vibhags of 2, used in pakhawaj and kathak. Built on Dha/Kita/Dhin phrasing with the seven-fold clap-wave alternation; sam on 1.

name: Lakshmi Tal (36, expanded)
desc: The expanded 36-matra (dugun) form of Lakshmi Tal used in pakhawaj and kathak, doubling the 18-matra cycle with resonant dha/dhin phrasing and the customary clap-wave alternation; sam on 1.
